East Prussia ( German : Ostpreußen [ˈɔstˌpʁɔɪ̯sn̩] ⓘ ) [ Note 1 ] was a province of the Kingdom of Prussia from 1772 to 1829 and again from 1878 (with the Kingdom itself being part of the German Empire from 1871); following World War I it formed part of the Weimar Republic 's Free State of Prussia , until 1945. Its capital city was Königsberg (present-day Kaliningrad ). East Prussia was the main part of the region of Prussia along the southeastern Baltic Coast . [ 1 ]
